allocation_complete.reason: The element has no allocates link.

completeness.reason: The parent's obligation is to provide a CCS2 inlet; no part of this element provides one, and in MCS products ARCH_CHG_INLET is an MCS inlet only, so the CCS2 inlet is covered nowhere.
completeness.suggestion: Add the CCS2 inlet (e.g. in the plain/MCS ARCH_CHG_INLET variants) or an inlet element satisfying REQ_EU_CHARGING_STANDARD.

consistency.reason: Sole element satisfying REQ_EU_CHARGING_STANDARD; no sibling to contradict.

design_clarity.reason: Names CCS2 and ISO 15118 but not the part/version (ISO 15118-2 vs -20, DIN 70121 fallback) nor where the charging current limit comes from (BMS limits).
design_clarity.suggestion: Name the ISO 15118 edition(s) supported and the source of the current limit.

implementability.reason: Realisable, but the protocol edition and the current-limit source are judgement calls for the implementer.
implementability.suggestion: Fix the protocol edition and current-limit source.

interface_only.reason: The element has no allocates link.

no_value_copy.reason: No BMS value (limit, threshold, timing) is named.

parent_fit.reason: REQ_EU_CHARGING_STANDARD asks for a CCS2 inlet per IEC 62196-3 (the physical coupler); this element runs the CCS2 session and sets the current limit, which engages the parent only tangentially.
parent_fit.suggestion: Satisfy the inlet obligation with an inlet element (CCS2 inlet), and trace the session control to a requirement on charging communication.

variant_consistency.reason: EU variant: gated var.market.region == 'eu' inside the bev-only chg folder, equal to REQ_EU_CHARGING_STANDARD (region/eu folder + bev).
